## Overview

This release provides prebuilt `gx` binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

## Assets

- Download the archive that matches your platform.
- Verify the archive with `checksums.txt` before use.
- Extract the archive and run `gx --help` to confirm the binary works.

## Notes

- The changelog below is generated from the commits and pull requests included in this release.
- GitHub Actions builds and publishes these artifacts automatically from pushed `v*` tags.
